detail.sDescription: A modified OBIR with greatly improved accuracy whilst in marksmanship mode, greatly improved effective range and a tagger to highlight foes hit by your bullets.

eFnMod_0.sDescription:
Upper Rail Modification -
Pin-hole target aperture sight greatly improves accuracy when focusing in marksmanship mode.

aModifierEffects.sDescription: <Color:R=0 G=1 B=0>Substantially<Color:R=1 G=1 B=1> improves benefit of marksmanship mode
<Color:R=0.7 G=0.7 B=0>+5 degrees<Color:R=1 G=1 B=1> zoom level
<Color:R=1 G=0 B=0>Substantially<Color:R=1 G=1 B=1> decreases accuracy while running

eFnMod_1.sDescription:
Barrel Modification -
Precision laser-cut polygonal rifling helps improve the operational range of the weapon, slightly increasing the range while reducing fire rate to protect the barrel.

aModifierEffects.sDescription: <Color:R=0 G=1 B=0>+7m<Color:R=1 G=1 B=1> effective range
<Color:R=1 G=0 B=0>Substantially<Color:R=1 G=1 B=1> increases maximum reticle bloom

eFnMod_2.sDescription:
Receiver Modification -
RFID Tags attached to fired rounds effectively mark enemy targets, highlighting them on your Heads Up Display for you and your team.

aModifierEffects.sDescription: Places <Color:R=1 G=0.95 B=0>a Target Marker<Color:R=1 G=1 B=1> above targets that you hit, for 8 seconds.
Enemy player can see when they are tagged.
